name: NEXTDC P1 Perth Stage 2

address.note: Address per Multiplex/Industrialist. DA DAP/24/02641 covers Lot 101 (No. 10) Malaga Drive (existing P1), Lot 327 (No. 10) and Lot 328 (No. 12) Millrose Drive, Malaga (source 6); combined site 10,858 sqm (source 4)

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '4 Millrose Drive, Malaga WA 6090' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100).

builder.note: head contractor; 'fifth data centre Multiplex has contracted for NEXTDC' (sources 3, 7)

mw_it.note: incremental IT capacity: Multiplex project page (source 1, search extract only; page blocks automated fetch) says Stage 2 doubles P1 long-term IT capacity from 6 MW to 12 MW with a new 1,069 sqm data hall; press releases read in full say it will 'double the data centre's current IT capacity' (sources 3, 7). NEXTDC 1H26 ASX release lists 2 MW 'continues to be progressed' at P1 Perth at 31 Dec 2025 (source 8) - likely the initial fit-out tranche, not total stage capacity. DAP presentation: six-storey building, approx. 6,670 sqm floor area, data halls on floors 1-3 (source 6)

cost_aud_m.note: AUD 110m investment per Multiplex/NEXTDC top-out release (Nov 2025; sources 2, 7). Alternative: DA estimated development cost AUD 56.4m (source 4); consistent with the DAP public-art condition (1% of construction value, cash-in-lieu $479,271.65 after 15% discount, implying approx. AUD 56.4m construction value; source 6)

authority.value: Metro Outer Development Assessment Panel (WA DAP), meeting MODAP/11; City of Swan responsible authority
authority.note: Echo Newspaper calls it 'Outer Metro DAP'

pathway.note: use classed as 'Data Centre (Warehouse)'; zoned General Industrial; plot ratio 2.4:1 proposed vs 0.6:1 control

reference.note: printed as 'DAP//24/02641' on the presentation forms

lodged.note: not found; responsible authority report (Part A/B agenda) for MODAP/11 not retrievable from the DAP site

determined.note: MODAP/11 meeting 8 May 2024; approval reported by Echo Newspaper (source 4)

jobs_construction_other.note: '95 people are working on the construction each day' at top-out, Nov 2025 (source 7; source 3: '95 workers onsite daily'); point-in-time daily headcount, not stated as peak; 154,055 combined hours worked to date

jobs_operational.note: No operational jobs figure. DA condition limits the site to a maximum of 38 people (staff and customers) at any one time; the original condition also allowed up to 90 employees in emergency periods (sources 4, 6). Not an operational jobs figure.

construction_start.note: start date not found; DA approved 8 May 2024, topped out 18 Nov 2025

construction_end.note: expected: practical completion scheduled Q3 2026 (sources 3, 7, Nov 2025); completion not confirmed as of 2026-09-27

open_questions: planning lodged date not found (DAP responsible authority report not retrieved)
